example_sentences_in_bangla: তার সম্পত্তি এত বেশি যে সে ধনেশ্বরের মতো।
ধনেশ্বরের কথা মনে পড়ে যায় তার বিলাসবহুল জীবন দেখে।
example_sentences_in_english: His wealth is so vast that he is like Dhoneshwar.
Seeing his luxurious life reminds one of Dhoneshwar.
history: Refers to Kubera, the Hindu deity of wealth from ancient Puranic texts like the Mahabharata and Ramayana.
note: This term is often used metaphorically to denote extreme wealth, drawing from Hindu mythology.
